newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Rangebound gilts eye 111-22 on downside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Rangebound gilts eye 111-22 on downside.

text.p: LIFFE June gilt futures could feature sideways movements on Friday, but the bias is still on the downside, technical analysts said.
A small bounce was possible, but gains above Wednesday's high of 112-21 would be hard fought for now, they added.
"It's looking more corrective than strong. The intraday momentum is still on the downside, so we could see some more bearish ranging," said Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST in London.
He pegged the initial downside target at 111-22.
By 0705 GMT, June gilt future was 2/32 down at 112-08.
